rendered:
The clinical sepsis samples came from septic patients with infections caused by bacteria of the following species: E. coli[1] and E. faecium[2]. The paper describes them as septic patients with confirmed E. coli[3] infection and septic patients with confirmed E. faecium infection[4].

The control group was healthy volunteers serving as the control[5], whose serum was sampled alongside the septic groups. The LDA plot in the figure below shows the E. coli, E. faecium and Healthy groups.
Fig. 5[6]
